detail: base determination: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (deterministic mapping). Anchor verified by parameter-set dump: pure graphite negative (no SiOx keys; negative density 1657 kg/m3, particle radius 5.86 um), NMC811 positive (density 3262 kg/m3), nominal 5 Ah, SEI kinetics present (SEI kinetic rate constant [m.s-1]=1e-12) -> aging-capable. Materials use system baseline (this case starts at Stage 3). Opening ceiling assessment (executed on baseline measurements): (1) ED: baseline 400.75 Wh/kg already exceeds 327.18 target - ED not a binding constraint, no material escalation for ED. (2) SEI@500cyc: baseline 777.9 nm vs 550 nm; in the ec-reaction-limited SEI model per-area SEI thickness growth is set by material kinetics (SEI kinetic rate constant), no architecture lever (particle size/porosity/N-P do not scale per-area ec-limited thickness) - objective exceeds the system ceiling on this metric -> PROACTIVE ESCALATION to Stage 2 coating candidate (SEI kinetic rate constant reduction via ceramic-coated anode; bridge value marked estimate, validated in Stage 3 aging on the same system). (3) 4C plating and lowT retention: architecture levers assessed first (negative particle radius, N/P, electrode porosity); electrolyte-formulation escalation (sigma/D transport overrides) held in reserve - note: Chen2020 electrolyte conductivity/diffusivity are temperature-dependent functions (Nyman2008); a scalar override would remove the low-T transport degradation and flatter the -20 C retention, so any such escalation must be recorded as upper-bound estimate. (4) lowT protocol quirk found and fixed: ambient-only temperature setting leaves the lumped initial condition at 298.15 K; cold-start rerun with Initial temperature [K]=253.15 gives the honest -20 C measurement.
